import http.client, json, os, signal, subprocess, tempfile, time
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
data = Path(tmp.name) / 'nested' / 'data.json'

def start():
    p = subprocess.Popen(['python3', 'server.py', '--host', '127.0.0.1', '--port', '0', '--data', str(data)], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE, text=True)
    line = p.stdout.readline().strip()
    assert line.startswith('LISTENING '), (line, p.stderr.read())
    return p, int(line.split()[1])

def request(port, method, path, body=None, headers=None):
    c = http.client.HTTPConnection('127.0.0.1', port, timeout=3)
    payload = None if body is None else (body if isinstance(body, bytes) else json.dumps(body).encode())
    h = dict(headers or {})
    if payload is not None:
        h.setdefault('Content-Type', 'application/json')
        h.setdefault('Content-Length', str(len(payload)))
    c.request(method, path, payload, h)
    r = c.getresponse(); raw = r.read(); hs = dict(r.getheaders()); c.close()
    parsed = json.loads(raw) if raw else None
    return r.status, parsed, hs

p, port = start()
try:
    assert request(port, 'GET', '/health')[:2] == (200, {'status':'ok'})
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', {'value': {'x':[1,True,None]}})[:2] == (201, {'key':'hello world','value':{'x':[1,True,None]}})
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', {'value': 2})[0] == 200
    assert request(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world')[:2] == (200, {'key':'hello world','value':2})
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', {'value':'a'})[0] == 201
    assert request(port, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[:2] == (200, {'keys':['a','hello world']})
    assert request(port, 'POST', '/health', {})[0] == 405
    assert request(port, 'GET', '/nope')[0] == 404
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', b'{')[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', {'ttl_seconds':1})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', {'value':1,'ttl_seconds':0})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/a', {'value':1,'extra':2})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/%2F', {'value':1})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/', {'value':1})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/big', b'x'*(1024*1024+1))[0] == 413
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/short', b'{}', {'Content-Length':'100'})[0] == 400
    assert request(port, 'PUT', '/v1/kv/ttl', {'value':'gone','ttl_seconds':0.15})[0] == 201
    time.sleep(.22)
    assert request(port, 'GET', '/v1/kv/ttl')[0] == 404
    assert request(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/a')[0] == 204
    assert request(port, 'DELETE', '/v1/kv/a')[0] == 404
finally:
    p.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p.returncode == 0, (p.returncode, p.stderr.read())

p2, port2 = start()
try:
    assert request(port2, 'GET', '/v1/keys')[:2] == (200, {'keys':['hello world']})
    assert request(port2, 'GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world')[:2] == (200, {'key':'hello world','value':2})
finally:
    p2.send_signal(signal.SIGTERM); p2.wait(timeout=5)
    assert p2.returncode == 0, (p2.returncode, p2.stderr.read())
assert data.exists()
print('SELF_TEST_OK')
PY"

import io
import json
import math
import os
import tempfile
import time
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch

import server

# Store lifecycle, replacement, TTL cleanup, sorting, deletion, and restart persistence.
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    path = Path(td) / 'nested' / 'store.json'
    store = server.Store(path)
    assert store.keys() == []
    assert store.put('b', {'n': 1}, None) is False
    assert store.put('a key', [1, True, None], None) is False
    assert store.put('b', 2, None) is True
    assert store.get('b') == 2
    assert store.keys() == ['a key', 'b']
    assert server.Store(path).get('a key') == [1, True, None]
    assert store.delete('b') is True
    assert store.delete('b') is False
    assert server.Store(path).keys() == ['a key']

    store.put('short', 'gone', time.time() + 0.02)
    time.sleep(0.03)
    assert store.get('short') is None
    assert 'short' not in json.loads(path.read_text())['entries']

    expired_doc = {'version': 1, 'entries': {'old': {'value': 1, 'expires_at': time.time()-10}, 'live': {'value': 2, 'expires_at': None}}}
    path.write_text(json.dumps(expired_doc), encoding='utf-8')
    restarted = server.Store(path)
    assert restarted.keys() == ['live']
    assert set(json.loads(path.read_text())['entries']) == {'live'}

# Build handlers without sockets and exercise request parsing/routing through captured output.
class FakeServer:
    store = None

def run(method, target, body=b'', headers=None, store=None):
    cls = server.KVHandler
    h = object.__new__(cls)
    h.command = method
    h.path = target
    h.headers = {'Content-Length': str(len(body)), **(headers or {})}
    h.rfile = io.BytesIO(body)
    h.wfile = io.BytesIO()
    h.server = FakeServer()
    h.server.store = store
    h.request_version = 'HTTP/1.1'
    h.close_connection = False
    captured = {}
    h.send_response = lambda status: captured.setdefault('status', status)
    h.send_header = lambda key, value: captured.setdefault('headers', {}) .__setitem__(key, value)
    h.end_headers = lambda: None
    getattr(h, 'do_' + method)()
    raw = h.wfile.getvalue()
    return captured['status'], (json.loads(raw) if raw else None), captured.get('headers', {}), h

with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as td:
    store = server.Store(Path(td) / 'data.json')
    assert run('GET', '/health', store=store)[:2] == (200, {'status': 'ok'})
    assert run('PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', b'{\"value\":{\"x\":1}}', store=store)[:2] == (201, {'key':'hello world','value':{'x':1}})
    assert run('PUT', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', b'{\"value\":2}', store=store)[0] == 200
    assert run('GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', store=store)[:2] == (200, {'key':'hello world','value':2})
    assert run('GET', '/v1/keys', store=store)[:2] == (200, {'keys':['hello world']})
    assert run('DELETE', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', store=store)[0] == 204
    assert run('GET', '/v1/kv/hello%20world', store=store)[0] == 404
    for target in ['/v1/kv/', '/v1/kv/a/b', '/v1/kv/%2F', '/v1/kv/%ZZ', '/v1/kv/%FF']:
        assert run('GET', target, store=store)[0] == 400, target
    bad_bodies = [b'{', b'[]', b'{}', b'{\"value\":1,\"extra\":2}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":0}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":true}', b'{\"value\":1,\"ttl_seconds\":1e999}']
    for body in bad_bodies:
        assert run('PUT', '/v1/kv/a', body, store=store)[0] == 400, body
    assert run('PUT', '/v1/kv/a', b'x'*(server.MAX_BODY+1), store=store)[0] == 413
    assert run('POST', '/health', b'{}', store=store)[0] == 405
    assert run('GET', '/unknown', store=store)[0] == 404
    assert run('GET', '/health?x=1', store=store)[0] == 200

print('NON_NETWORK_TESTS_OK')
